title: The Evil Sorcerer
author: Gren Remoz
description: In this fantasy game, you play as a man named George waking up in someone else's bedroom and wearing unfamiliar clothes. Memories return slowly of drinking at a party, meeting a stunningly beautiful woman named Julia, leaving with her in her car, somehow arriving at an island beach in a far-away empire, making love, learning magic is real, and learning that she wants you to kill an evil sorcerer on her lands.
